title: Soul Snack #77: You Were Born To Choose Love
excerpt: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world.
bodyHtml:
Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE

In this soul-stirring Soul Snack, Gary Zukav speaks directly to the heart of what it means to be alive in this unprecedented moment of human evolution. As a new consciousness reshapes the entire human species.

Gary presents each listener with a fundamental choice: will you orient your life toward gratitude, patience, contentment, and awe – or remain in the familiar grip of fear and doubt? 

This Soul Snack is both an invitation and a roadmap for those ready to walk the path of authentic transformation.

At the center of Gary’s teaching is the recognition that the frightened parts of our personality – those deeply ingrained patterns of reactivity and self-protection – will continue to run the show until we make a conscious, intentional choice to move beyond them. The challenge is not simply wanting to change; it is summoning the genuine, soul level intention to align your personality with your soul and create Authentic Power.

The path forward is clear: scan your body for emotional currents, set your intention, and choose love over fear in each moment. By doing so, you become a spiritual partner – to yourself, and to those around you. As Gary reminds us, you were born to do this. Why not begin now?

What You’ll Discover in ThisSoul Snack:

  • (00:02) — A New World Being Born: Gary describes the unprecedented evolution of the human species – from five-sensory to multi-sensory – and the moment-by-moment choice we each face between two worlds.
  • (00:30) — The Essence of Authentic Power: How to align your personality with your soul. Gary makes it clear: without a conscious intention, this alignment – and your spiritual evolution—simply cannot happen.
  • (01:03) — Intention as the Only Lever: Only your own sincere, soul-level intention can move you beyond the control of the frightened parts of your personality. No one can do this work for you.
  • (01:30) — The Choice for Love: Gary illuminates the core practice of spiritual awareness: distinguishing the frequency of love from the frequency of fear within your own body – and choosing love, unconditionally.
  • (02:00) — The Path of Spiritual Partnership: Gary invites you into a new way of relating – as equals who are joined together for the purpose of spiritual growth.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

Pause and reflect: where in your life are the frightened parts of your personality still making decisions for you? Identify one moment this week when you felt fear, anger, or overwhelm  – and ask yourself: what would it have looked like to choose love instead? Set a clear intention today. Say it aloud or write it down: “I intend to align my personality with my soul and create Authentic Power in my life.” Notice what shifts when you do.
